title: 订单数
question: 上个月各区域的订单数
sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
